oligo_notes: Described only as 'a 2'-MOE ASO' used as the thrombocytopenia-inducing probe in Mauritian- vs Asian-sourced cynomolgus monkeys.
effect_vs_control: serum anti-GPIIb/IIIa IgG correlated with platelet reduction
source_ref: PMID 37093125 / doi:10.1089/nat.2022.0042 (Shen et al. 2023, Nucleic Acid Ther 33:209-225)
measurement_notes: Same antigen target (GPIIb/IIIa) that Ionis reported for the antiplatelet IgG in the human grade-4 inotersen cases - a direct monkey/human mechanistic bridge. Total serum IgM, anti-platelet IgM and anti-PF4 IgM also rose in both monkey sources but more markedly in Mauritian animals.

oligo_notes: Described only as 'a 2'-MOE ASO' used as the thrombocytopenia-inducing probe in Mauritian- vs Asian-sourced cynomolgus monkeys.
effect_vs_control: marked increase in all thrombocytopenic Mauritian monkeys; not increased in unaffected Mauritian- or Asian-sourced animals
source_ref: PMID 37093125 / doi:10.1089/nat.2022.0042 (Shen et al. 2023, Nucleic Acid Ther 33:209-225)
measurement_notes: Complement deposition on the platelet surface as the clearance mechanism, and independent of ASO-mediated fluid-phase alternative-pathway activation. Provides a candidate translational biomarker.

oligo_notes: Described only as 'a 2'-MOE ASO' used as the thrombocytopenia-inducing probe in Mauritian- vs Asian-sourced cynomolgus monkeys.
effect_vs_control: no severe thrombocytopenia in Asian-sourced monkeys at the same dose/duration
source_ref: PMID 37093125 / doi:10.1089/nat.2022.0042 (Shen et al. 2023, Nucleic Acid Ther 33:209-225)
measurement_notes: MEASURED GRADE 0 for the severe endpoint - the same ASO at the same dose induced no severe thrombocytopenia in Asian-sourced animals ('induced severe TCP in seven of nine Mauritian-sourced monkeys but not in the Asian-sourced monkeys'). Note: this is grade 0 for the <50 x10^9/L endpoint only; the abstract does not exclude a milder mean decline in these animals.

oligo_notes: Described only as 'a 2'-MOE ASO' used as the thrombocytopenia-inducing probe in Mauritian- vs Asian-sourced cynomolgus monkeys.
effect_vs_control: severe thrombocytopenia (<50 x10^9/L) in 7 of 9 Mauritian-sourced monkeys
source_ref: PMID 37093125 / doi:10.1089/nat.2022.0042 (Shen et al. 2023, Nucleic Acid Ther 33:209-225)
measurement_notes: Mauritian-sourced cynomolgus monkeys are markedly MORE susceptible to 2'-MOE-ASO-induced thrombocytopenia than Asian-sourced animals. This is a major confounder for animal-to-human translation: the apparent incidence of severe ASO thrombocytopenia in monkey depends on the colony source, so a monkey study's predicted human risk is source-dependent.

oligo_notes: Per-position sugar chemistry as printed in Table 37: eeeeeddddddddddeeeee (e = 2'-MOE, k = constrained ethyl (cEt), d = 2'-deoxynucleoside). Chemistry string length equals sequence length, which is the length check applied. All internucleoside linkages phosphorothioate; all cytosines 5-methylcytosine (patent chemistry statement).
measurement_notes: Example 39: 35 mg/kg subcutaneous, loading doses on days 1/3/5/7 then once weekly for weeks 2-12; blood for hematology collected on day 44 (ADVIA120 analyser). NOTE: the Table 45 caption in the patent is misprinted as 'Complement C3 levels in cynomolgus monkeys' but its column headers are 'Platelet count (x10^3/uL)' and 'RBC count (x10^6/uL)'; recorded from the column header, and the caption error is flagged rather than silently corrected. This is a cEt-vs-MOE, 16-mer-vs-20-mer chemistry panel with no platelet decline in any arm.
